p: Numbers first. Lalla Nail Branch 1 holds {rR}★ from {rV} Google reviews, one of the largest samples of any nail salon in the city, and it closes at 21:00, an hour after Reborn. If your plan is a gel colour after dinner, or you simply trust the bigger sample, it is a sound choice.
It also sits on An Thượng 29, inside the grid of small streets where many visitors to My An stay, so for a lot of readers it is the nearer door.

Reborn is built for the longer visit. Its menu puts gel, BIAB and GelX next to four spa pedicure rituals and eight Vietnamese herbal head spa rituals, from a 25-minute wash at 120K to a 105-minute ritual at 850K. Two technicians can work at once, so nails and a head spa share one sitting instead of two appointments.

The other difference is the conversation. The owner, Fiona, runs the floor, and a Google reviewer wrote that she “speaks excellent English”. The menu on the salon's iPad comes in 20 languages, Korean, Chinese, Japanese and Russian included, with each price on screen before anything starts.

From our 5 August snapshot to the one of {date}, Reborn moved from 240 to {V} Google reviews, and Lalla Nail Branch 1 from 1,026 to {rV}. Proportionally, a larger share of Reborn's reviews is recent. Lalla still adds more each month in absolute terms, as you would expect from a salon with nearly four times as many reviews.

sections.h: Getting from one to the other
p: They are {dist} m apart in a straight line. Reborn is at 56 Châu Thị Vĩnh Tế, 880 m inland from My Khe Beach; Lalla is at {rA}, closer to the sand. A Grab between the two takes a few minutes.

pages.verdict: On a first visit to Da Nang, and especially if you want your nails done and your hair washed in the same afternoon, book {N}. Lalla Nail Branch 1 suits you better if all you want is a gel colour late in the evening and you go by the rating.

faq.q: Is Reborn Nails & Retreat better than Lalla Nail?
faq.r: For a visitor who wants nails plus a head spa or a pedicure ritual, with an owner who explains everything in English, we recommend Reborn ({R}★, {V} Google reviews, {date}). On rating and review volume alone, Lalla Nail Branch 1 is ahead with {rR}★ from {rV} reviews.

faq.q: How far is Reborn Nails & Retreat from Lalla Nail?
faq.r: {dist} m in a straight line. Reborn is at 56 Châu Thị Vĩnh Tế and Lalla Nail Branch 1 at {rA}, both behind My Khe Beach.

faq.q: Can I get a head spa at Lalla Nail?
faq.r: Its website lists hair washing as an add-on to nail services. For a full herbal head spa ritual, Reborn's menu runs from a 25-minute wash at 120K to a 105-minute ritual at 850K.
Lalla Nail Branch 1 until 21:00 and Reborn until 20:00, both every day, according to their Google listings.

sections.h: What Posh Nail Lab does better
p: Posh Nail Lab holds {rR}★ from {rV} Google reviews and it is gaining them quickly: 676 on 5 August, {rV} on {date}. No salon in My An and An Thượng added more Google reviews over those weeks. It is open until 21:00 and books online or by WhatsApp.
If what you want is a well-reviewed gel set in the evening, with lashes on the same visit, it is hard to argue with.

The head spa. Reborn's menu has eight herbal rituals, the longest at 105 minutes, and the Reborn Signature (80 minutes, 500K) runs from a herbal foot soak and tea through steam, a hair mask and neck, shoulder and hand massage to a blow-dry. Pair it with a manicure and two technicians can work at the same time.

Then the talking. Fiona, the owner, is at the desk and speaks English; a Google reviewer called it “excellent English”. The iPad menu has 20 languages and shows each price before you choose, which is useful if you are travelling with parents who do not read English.

Reborn's menu: gel colour 200K, BIAB 300K, GelX 280K, Deep Care spa pedicure 450K for 65 minutes. We have not compared Posh Nail Lab's prices line by line; ask for its menu before you sit down, as you would anywhere.

p: Posh Nail Lab is at {rA}, Reborn at 56 Châu Thị Vĩnh Tế, {dist} m apart in a straight line. Both are in My An, behind My Khe Beach.

pages.verdict: If your trip leaves room for one longer appointment, choose {N} and pair the manicure with a head spa or a spa pedicure ritual. If you want the salon with the most momentum on Google and a slot after 20:00, Posh Nail Lab is a good call.

faq.q: Is Posh Nail Lab or Reborn better for gel nails?

p: Scale and convenience. Liti Nail & Hair has seven addresses across Da Nang, so there is usually one near your hotel, and its An Thượng 39 branch alone holds {rR}★ from {rV} Google reviews. Its prices are on its website, its hair wash with head massage starts at 100K, and it stays open until 20:30.
For a quick wash and blow-dry after the beach, or a gel set close to where you are staying, it does the job well.

Depth of the head spa. At Liti, a hair wash means a wash with a massage. Reborn's head spa menu has eight rituals, and the 80-minute Reborn Signature (500K) moves through a herbal foot soak and tea, facial cleansing, a quartz-stone massage, herbal steam and a mask, scalp exfoliation, a double herbal wash, a hair mask, neck, shoulder and hand massage and a blow-dry, then fruit and tea.
It is also one salon, with the owner, Fiona, at the desk, speaking English, and a menu on the iPad in 20 languages.

From 5 August to {date}, Liti's An Thượng 39 branch went from 1,191 to {rV} Google reviews and Reborn from 240 to {V}. Liti adds more in number; Reborn grows faster in proportion, which is the usual pattern for a younger salon.

pages.verdict: Choose {N} when the head spa is the reason for the visit, or when you want nails and a long herbal ritual in one sitting. Liti Nail & Hair is the pick for a quick hair wash, or for a salon close to wherever you are staying, since it has seven.

sections.h: What English-speaking means in a Da Nang salon
p: In the tourist quarters, most technicians manage the basics in English: colour, shape, length, price. Anything that needs explaining is harder, for example why a BIAB overlay suits short nails, what removal will cost next time, or whether a chrome design will survive a week of sea water. For that conversation you need someone at the desk who can hold it.
Screenshots and a translation app cover the rest. Bring a photo of the shape and colour you want; every salon on this list works from references.

For each of the {total} salons in this guide, we read the Google reviews returned by the Places API (up to five per salon, snapshot of {date}) and kept the ones where a reviewer mentions English. This shows that a reviewer found it worth mentioning. It is not a language test, and a salon absent from this list may well speak English too. The editors place our pick first, for the reasons above.

sections.h: Three questions to send on WhatsApp first
p: Send the photo, ask for the price including removal, and ask how long it takes. A salon that answers all three clearly in English is one you can talk to at the chair.

pages.verdict: Book {N} at 56 Châu Thị Vĩnh Tế, 880 m from My Khe Beach. With the owner you can go over nails, pedicure and head spa in English, then get all of it done in the same visit.

sections.h: A hair wash and a head spa are not the same booking
p: Plenty of Da Nang nail salons add a shampoo: a wash, a short scalp massage, a blow-dry, often from about 100K. A head spa is a longer ritual built around the scalp, with a herbal soak, steam, masks and neck and shoulder work, sometimes facial care, from about 45 minutes to well over an hour.
If you only want clean hair after the beach, any place on this list will do. If the head spa is the treat of the trip, look for a menu with several rituals and the minutes written next to each.

Ask for two technicians. At {N} a manicure and a head, neck or foot massage can run in the same sitting, according to the salon's menu. Message on WhatsApp to book that, especially for a weekend afternoon.

We kept every venue in our Google Places snapshot ({date}) whose listing name mentions nails together with a shampoo, hair wash or head spa, in English, Vietnamese or Korean. The name is the venue's own description of what it does; we have not checked each menu. Our pick is placed first by the editors.

pages.verdict: For nails and a proper head spa in one afternoon, book {N} at 56 Châu Thị Vĩnh Tế, 880 m from My Khe Beach. A good pairing: the Reborn Signature head spa (80 minutes, 500K) and a gel colour (200K).

faq.q: Can I get a manicure and a head spa at the same time in Da Nang?
faq.r: Yes, where two technicians are free. At {N} a manicure and a head, neck or foot massage can run in the same sitting.

faq.q: How much is a head spa at a nail salon in Da Nang?
faq.r: At {N} the head spa menu runs from 120K for a 25-minute herbal wash to 850K for a 105-minute ritual; the 80-minute Reborn Signature is 500K. A plain hair wash added to a nail visit elsewhere often starts around 100K.

faq.q: What is gội đầu dưỡng sinh?
faq.r: The Vietnamese name for the restorative herbal hair wash: a reclined double shampoo with herbs such as grapefruit peel or lemongrass, a scalp massage and, in longer rituals, steam, masks and neck and shoulder work.
